summary: Franklin County entry on a Georgia lookout list, with location, elevation and a GFC code; no build date, staffing or fate in the sources.

In 1806, Carnesville was named the permanent county seat in Franklin County, Georgia.

evidence.supports: faster detection and report means fire-suppression equipment reaches the blaze sooner

corrections.why: The list gives the code as gfc-919; it has no US prefix.

notes_for_editor: Only one list places this tower: the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (map revised 22 March 2016). It gives position, 794 ft elevation and gfc-919, but no status, height, design, staffing or fire record. Its 'datasheet ED1503' note is unexplained. Searches and cached pages (NHLR, FFLOS, Wikipedia, Georgia newspaper search) found nothing more; the newspaper search page did not render. The Harris County 1955 item is general context about Georgia lookout towers, not evidence about this tower. Proposed correction: the record's GFC number 'US 919' should read 919. Next checks: Georgia Forestry Commission tower files, Franklin County Historical Society, Georgia Historic Newspapers in a browser.
